title: Gridz Grid
description: Canonical data model for a Gridz Grid: a cryptographically-attested profile composed of typed, signed cells plus a rendering layout. This schema is the single source of truth; SDKs, CLI, MCP, and config authoring all validate against it.

did.description: W3C Decentralized Identifier. Supported methods: did:ethr, did:pkh, did:web, did:key, did:oneclaw. Other methods round-trip but are not first-class.

key.description: Field key. Inherited ENS global keys (lowercase + hyphen), ENS service keys (reverse dot notation), agent keys, or gridz.* widget keys. Dynamic keys are first-class.

type.description: What kind of entity this Grid describes.

ens.description: Human-readable ENS name. MUST resolve via real lookup; never assumed. Itself attested as a cell when present.

sns.description: Solana Name Service name. MUST resolve via real lookup; never assumed.

display_name.description: Optional human-readable label. Not authoritative; the alias cell is.

theme.description: Render theme. Derivable from the ENSIP-18 'theme' text record when present.

background_value.description: Color, CSS gradient string, or image URL depending on background_type.

font_family.description: One of the built-in stacks (sans|serif|mono) or a Google Fonts family name.

show_gridz_badge.description: Whether the renderer shows the Gridz attribution badge.

cssColor.description: A CSS color: hex, rgb(a), hsl(a), or a named color. Renderer enforces WCAG 4.5:1 contrast and falls back on failure.

cellSize.description: Render size hint as WxH grid units. Common values: 1x1, 2x1, 1x2, 2x2, 3x1, 3x2. Arbitrary WxH is allowed.

cell.description: A typed key-value pair with its own independently-verifiable attestation.

id.description: Stable, opaque cell identifier, unique within the Grid.

value.description: JSON-serializable value. Shape is constrained per-key by the widget/key schema registry (see specs/standard-keys.md). null is permitted only during authoring and MUST fail validation when _needs_input is set.

widget_type.description: Optional render hint. Unknown widget types fall back to the Generic renderer.

expires_at.description: ISO-8601 optional revocation deadline. After this instant the cell renders as expired (amber badge).

_needs_input.description: Authoring-only flag set by templates. A cell with _needs_input:true MUST fail `gridz grid validate` until the operator fills the value. Never present on a published Grid.

_unattested.description: Authoring-only flag set by import flows for cells derived from existing (e.g. ENS) records that the operator has not yet signed. MUST be resolved before publish.

then.$comment: Authoring guard surfaced to validators. Tooling treats _needs_input:true as a hard validation failure regardless of value.

schema_version.description: Pins the Grid model version. Bump on any breaking change to this schema.

cells.description: The Grid's cells. Each is independently verifiable; verifying one never requires the others.

root_attestation.description: Attestation over the sorted merkle root of cell attestation UIDs (see specs/canonicalization.md). Binds the set of cells together without making any single cell depend on the others.
